title: nbastatR
abstract: R interface to NBA Stats API plus Basketball-Reference, HoopsHype, RealGM, draft sources. Broad front-office oriented wrappers.

title: pbpstats
abstract: Python PBP parsing, lineups, on/off from NBA Stats feeds.

title: hoopR (sportsdataverse)
abstract: R package: ESPN NBA/NCAAM loads, NBA Stats API wrappers, Basketball-Reference scrapers, KenPom (subscription). load_nba_pbp covers multi-season ESPN PBP.

title: BasketballAnalyzeR
abstract: CRAN R package accompanying Basketball Data Science (CRC). Analysis/visualization helpers.

title: nba_api
abstract: Python client for NBA.com Stats API. Box scores, PBP, shot charts, tracking endpoints. Rate-limit / ToS sensitive; do not redistribute raw dumps without checking license.

title: Barttorvik (T-Rank) college basketball
abstract: Open-ish college ratings and team pages; KenPom alternative; verify scrape/ToS for bulk use.

title: Basketball-Reference
abstract: Canonical historical NBA/ABA/WNBA tables (season, advanced, salaries). Scrape-friendly with etiquette; not a bulk open dump license. Primary source for avg_game_by_decade season rows.

title: KenPom
abstract: Premium college efficiency ratings. Subscription for full tables. Cite-only / paywall for manuscript unless subscribed.

title: NBA Stats (stats.nba.com)
abstract: Official public stats site/API backing nba_api and R wrappers. Endpoints change; tracking/advanced splits uneven by era.

title: Basketball_reference_scraper
abstract: Python scraper for Basketball-Reference historical tables. Rate-limit politely; commercial ToS check before redistribute.

title: wyattowalsh/basketball (Kaggle / nbadb)
abstract: Large SQLite NBA historical DB (box, PBP, salaries, etc.). Parked for later; needs Kaggle auth; optional bulk land.

title: wehoop
abstract: R package for WNBA and women's college basketball via ESPN (PBP, box, standings).

title: Barttorvik T-Rank NCAA team ratings CSVs
abstract: Free Division I team ratings and four factors. Season-end CSVs e.g. {year}_team_results.csv. Open college efficiency path without KenPom.

title: awesome-nba-data living source matrix and ToS notes
abstract: Curation index and terms matrix for NBA data sources (not a license grant).
